name: Report of Loss, Damage or Theft of Federal Property
description: Investigated and documented report of loss, damage or theft affecting the program; if stolen items are not recovered, copies of the investigative report and insurance claim go to the awarding agency.
recipient: Federal agency or pass-through entity (and optionally local law enforcement)
quote: Any loss, damage or theft must be investigated, fully documented and reported to the federal agency or pass-through entity of any loss, damage or theft that will have an impact on the program.
